subtopic: What painting and related media involves
outcome: Develop knowledge and skills in a broad range of media, processes and techniques; demonstrate a personal response through painting and related media, working to a theme, starting point or brief, and show the ability to consider artistic constraints and problems, considering traditional, contemporary and emerging techniques and approaches.

subtopic: What painting and related media involves
outcome: Work in one or more of the following: painting; drawing; assemblage/collage; printmaking; mixed media.

subtopic: Researching and developing painting and related media work
outcome: Carry out visual research, using direct observation (first-hand) and secondary sources, and record observations, experiences and ideas in appropriate ways.

subtopic: Researching and developing painting and related media work
outcome: Explore and experiment with a wide range of different media (including recycled materials), techniques and processes.

subtopic: Researching and developing painting and related media work
outcome: Carry out in-depth research into artists, designers and cultural influences to inform the development of their ideas.

subtopic: Researching and developing painting and related media work
outcome: Select, review and refine their work throughout the whole process to produce a personal and resolved response.

subtopic: Painting and related media skills and techniques
outcome: Demonstrate the ability to use appropriate materials, including recycled material, and techniques to communicate their intention effectively.

subtopic: Painting and related media skills and techniques
outcome: Demonstrate an understanding of form, perspective and scale.

subtopic: Painting and related media skills and techniques
outcome: Demonstrate the ability to create images with consideration for space, balance and colour relationships.

subtopic: Painting and related media skills and techniques
outcome: Demonstrate effective use of a few appropriate skills such as tonal drawing, pen and ink, pastels, painting, printmaking, collage.

subtopic: Painting and related media skills and techniques
outcome: Demonstrate the ability to respond to a theme or given starting point.

subtopic: Knowledge and understanding of painting and related media
outcome: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of appropriate materials, processes, technologies and resources.

subtopic: Knowledge and understanding of painting and related media
outcome: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of how painting and related media can be used to communicate ideas and observations.

subtopic: Knowledge and understanding of painting and related media
outcome: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the importance of social and cultural factors.

subtopic: Knowledge and understanding of painting and related media
outcome: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of relevant painting and related media genres, styles and techniques used by artists, past and present.

subtopic: Knowledge and understanding of painting and related media
outcome: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the importance of intention, research, realisation and reflection to the artistic process.

subtopic: Researching and developing graphic communication work

subtopic: Researching and developing graphic communication work
outcome: Explore the relationship between image and text, the use of colour composition, problem-solving and communication to develop ideas.

subtopic: Researching and developing graphic communication work
outcome: Select, review and refine their work throughout the whole process to produce a personal and resolved response.

subtopic: What three-dimensional design involves
outcome: Develop knowledge and skills in a broad range of media, processes and techniques; demonstrate understanding of the development of designs for a three-dimensional outcome, working to a theme or brief and considering design constraints and problems, considering traditional, contemporary and emerging techniques and approaches.

outcome: Work in one or more of the following: sculpture/ceramics; product design; architectural: interior design/set design; craft design: metalwork, papercrafts and woodwork; jewellery and fashion accessories.

subtopic: Researching and developing three-dimensional design work
outcome: Carry out visual research, using direct observation (first-hand) and secondary sources, and record observations, experiences and ideas in appropriate ways to show clear evidence of the development of their ideas.

subtopic: Researching and developing three-dimensional design work
outcome: Explore and experiment with a wide range of different media, techniques and processes such as clay, plaster, cardboard, metal, string and tape and recycled material to develop maquettes for further development.

subtopic: Researching and developing three-dimensional design work
outcome: Carry out in-depth research into images and resources related to three-dimensional design, which reference a range of cultural, social and local contexts.

subtopic: Researching and developing three-dimensional design work
outcome: Explore form, function and surface using models, samples, materials exploration and technical notes to develop their ideas.

subtopic: Researching and developing three-dimensional design work
outcome: Select, review and refine their work throughout the whole process to plan and produce a personal and resolved response.

subtopic: Three-dimensional design skills and techniques
outcome: Demonstrate the ability to use appropriate materials and techniques to communicate their intention effectively.

subtopic: Three-dimensional design skills and techniques
outcome: Demonstrate an understanding of form, structure and scale.

subtopic: Three-dimensional design skills and techniques
outcome: Demonstrate the ability to create designs with consideration of texture, shape, colour and movement.

subtopic: Three-dimensional design skills and techniques
outcome: Demonstrate effective use of a few appropriate specialist working processes and equipment such as kilns, CAD, laser cutters and hand tools.

subtopic: Three-dimensional design skills and techniques

subtopic: Knowledge and understanding of three-dimensional design

subtopic: Knowledge and understanding of textiles and fashion

subtopic: Knowledge and understanding of textiles and fashion

subtopic: Knowledge and understanding of textiles and fashion

subtopic: Knowledge and understanding of textiles and fashion

subtopic: What photography involves
outcome: Develop knowledge of skills and processes relevant to photography; understand formal elements, animation, film or game design such as using narrative and visual language to create meaning, and using composition and planning layouts (drawing skills for animation could include character development, background and storyboards); use appropriate specialist technical language and support creative work with technical notes and records.

subtopic: What photography involves
outcome: Work in one or more of the following: traditional film photography; digital photography; camera-less photography; animation: hand-drawn or computer-aided or a combination; photomontage or photocollage.

subtopic: Researching and developing photography work
outcome: Carry out visual research, using direct observation (first-hand) and secondary sources, and record observations, experiences and ideas in appropriate ways to show clear evidence of the development of their ideas.

subtopic: Researching and developing photography work
outcome: Explore and experiment with techniques relevant to photography such as depth of field, lighting and exposure, aperture/shutter speed, angle and view-point/composition, framing and editing.

subtopic: Researching and developing photography work
outcome: Explore and experiment with different photographic media and processes such as abstracting, documenting, developing and printing of films, pin-hole camera, photograms, multiple exposure, photosensitive surfaces and alternative print processes, image scanning and manipulation and digital manipulation.

subtopic: Researching and developing photography work
outcome: For animation, film and game design, explore relevant media and processes such as hand-drawn, stop motion or digital animation.

subtopic: Researching and developing photography work
outcome: Select, review and refine their work throughout the process to produce a personal response.

subtopic: Photography skills and techniques
outcome: Demonstrate storyboarding and image-making through photography, model-making, drawing and/or illustration.

subtopic: Photography skills and techniques
outcome: Demonstrate an understanding of the conventions of photography and genres such as portrait, landscape and documentary.

subtopic: Photography skills and techniques
outcome: Demonstrate the ability to respond to a theme or brief.

subtopic: Photography skills and techniques
outcome: Demonstrate consideration of the intended audience for the work.

subtopic: Knowledge and understanding of photography
outcome: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of different types and genres of photography and/or animation.

subtopic: Knowledge and understanding of photography
outcome: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of appropriate materials, processes, technologies and resources.

subtopic: Knowledge and understanding of photography

subtopic: Knowledge and understanding of photography
outcome: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of a range of relevant artists, photographers or animators.
